summary: Carriage Services filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $100 million of common stock via sales agents Oppenheimer & Co. and Raymond James. Shares are sold on a continuous basis at prevailing market prices; no fixed price, premium, or discount. The board has not issued a recommendation. The offering is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), with no special-situation catalyst such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. What to watch: the pace and volume of share sales under the ATM, which could dilute existing holders but is not a transactional event.
